note: ACT takes the camera images as captured (480 × 640, height × width, in the paper's ALOHA rig): no resize or crop in the official code. It is not a ViT: each ResNet18 turns a 480 × 640 image into a 15 × 20 feature map, 300 tokens per image, so patch_px is null. The paper defines the ensembling weights w_i = exp(-m·i) (w_0 the oldest action) without a value for m; the official code uses k = 0.01, entered here. With ensembling the policy is queried every step (execute_steps 1); without it, the whole chunk of 100 is executed. The 10 ms inference time is on the training machine's 11 GB RTX 2080 Ti. Code MIT.
